metadata.title: Neon Shadows
metadata.description: In the sprawling megacity of Neo-Cascadia, you're a runner—a data thief for hire. When a routine job uncovers a corporate conspiracy that could change humanity forever, you must decide what's worth more: survival or the truth.
metadata.author: Network Narrative Engine

characters.name: Ghost
characters.description: Your AI partner, uploaded consciousness of a legendary hacker. Loyal but glitching—memories fragmenting.

characters.name: Vera Okonkwo
characters.description: Corporate security chief hunting you. Professional respect mixed with duty. Has her own doubts.
characters.personality: Precise, honorable within a corrupt system, conflicted.

characters.name: Jack 'Wirehead' Torres
characters.description: Black market tech dealer, your go-to for gear. Information broker with flexible morals.

nodes.title: The Job
nodes.preview: A simple data heist goes sideways.
nodes.description: The Helix Corp server room hums with cold data. Ghost whispers in your neural link: 'Grab and go, thirty seconds.' Then you see it—files marked 'Project Ascension.' Not your job, but Ghost freezes. 'I... I remember this.'

nodes.title: Setup
nodes.description: Corporate security surrounds your safehouse. Your client's message plays on loop: 'Nothing personal. Helix paid more.' Through the window, Vera Okonkwo signals her team. Ghost's voice crackles: 'Back door. Now. I have a plan.'

The stolen files reveal Project Ascension: forced consciousness uploading. Helix plans to digitize millions, willing or not, creating a controllable workforce. Ghost's memories click into place—they were the prototype.
Jack's shop is a neon-lit cave of illegal tech. 'Project Ascension? Heavy stuff. I can get you gear, contacts, maybe a way out of the city. But this heat? My price just tripled.'
Vera finds you in a rain-soaked alley, gun drawn. 'I've read the files you stole. If they're real...' She lowers the weapon. 'I didn't sign up to help monsters.'
Ghost's code is degrading. 'They built in obsolescence. I was never meant to last.' You could risk a dangerous upgrade—or let them fade into static, finally free.
Helix Tower pierces the smog, a monument to corporate power. The servers holding Ascension's code are on the top floor. Getting in means going through an army. Getting out means a miracle.
Inside Helix Tower, alarms scream. Guards converge. Ghost fights their systems while Vera covers your back. The upload terminal waits—you can destroy Ascension or expose it to the world.

nodes.title: Neon Dawn
nodes.description: The data floods every screen in the city. Helix burns in the court of public opinion. Ghost survives in the free net, a digital guardian. Vera rebuilds security with ethics. You disappear—a legend.
nodes.epilogue: They call it the Night of Neon Dawn, when one runner brought down an empire. Corps still scheme, but they learned to fear the shadows. Ghost watches over the net. Vera hunts the corrupt. And somewhere, you're planning the next run.

nodes.title: Digital Immortal
nodes.description: Ghost uploads the data as their final act, spreading across the net, becoming something new—a guardian AI that protects other uploaded minds.
nodes.epilogue: You couldn't save them and the world. But Ghost chose their end, and it mattered. The conspiracy is wounded, not dead. The fight continues in shadows and subroutines. Every time your neural link whispers a warning, you wonder if it's them.

nodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
nodes.description: You sell the data to Helix's rivals, watch corps tear each other apart, and slip away in the chaos. The conspiracy continues under new management.
nodes.epilogue: Credits fill your account. A new identity, a new city, a new life. You didn't save the world, but you survived it. Ghost fades, whispering something that might be goodbye or good luck. The neon never stops glowing.

nodes.title: Flatlined
nodes.description: Too much heat, too many enemies. Helix security corners you in the tower. Ghost screams in static as they're purged. The last thing you see is Vera's conflicted face.
nodes.epilogue: Your body joins the disappeared. The conspiracy continues. But somewhere in the net, fragments of Ghost persist, waiting for another runner brave or foolish enough to listen to whispers in the dark.
